title: San Sebastian Basque Burnt Cheesecake
hookLine: Caramelized dark burnished top with a molten custard cheesecake center — zero crust needed.

steps.title: Set Up Heavy Saucepan & Ingredients
steps.instructionTemplate: Place a heavy-bottomed saucepan over medium-low heat and have a heatproof silicone whisk ready. Measure out {cream_cheese}, {sugar_bc}, and {eggs_bc} and {cream_bc} and {flour_bc} in advance—stovetop desserts move fast once they start bubbling.

steps.title: Silky Cream Cheese & Sugar
steps.instructionTemplate: Beat {cream_cheese} and {sugar_bc} until completely smooth with zero lumps. Keep {cream_cheese} and {sugar_bc} prepped and measured within reach so each step comes together smoothly and evenly.

steps.title: Emulsify Custard Batter
steps.instructionTemplate: Whisk in {eggs_bc} one at a time, then pour in {cream_bc} and sift {flour_bc}. Stir gently to avoid excess air bubbles. Sifting aerates the dry ingredients and removes any stubborn cocoa or flour lumps so the finished crumb bakes up light and even.
steps.creatorSecret: Room-temperature cream cheese is the #1 secret to zero-lump Basque batter.

steps.title: Bake at 425°F for the Signature Burn
steps.instructionTemplate: Pour into a crumpled parchment-lined 8-inch springform pan. Bake at 425°F (220°C) for 32 minutes until deeply bronzed on top and jiggly in the center.
steps.criticalTip: CRITICAL: Chill at least 4 hours before slicing for custard perfection, or serve slightly warm for molten spoonfuls.
steps.creatorSecret: Dip a sharp knife in hot water and wipe dry between every cut for razor-clean cafe slices.

ugcQuotes.quote: Turned out bakery-grade on my first try! Ready in 44 mins.
